 Ryan Lovell – Chainlink: The Infrastructure Pipes for Multi-Chain Finance (EP.491) Mar 12, 2026

 Ryan Lovell is the Director of Capital Markets
at Chainlink Labs, where he leads the development of
blockchain-based solutions for tokenized finance across banking and
capital markets. Chainlink has powered more than $28
trillion in transaction value and powers the majority of
decentralized finance.

 

Our conversation explores the hidden plumbing of modern finance and
the upgrade blockchains provide. We
discuss Chainlink’s critical role in connecting
traditional finance with blockchain technology, the rise of
tokenization and stablecoins, institutional adoption, and the
intersection of AI and blockchains around a single
source of truth for financial transactions.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
